    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """
    3: S83 Wave 3 Gate G29 -- MULTIPAIR-N3-SATURATION
    4: ==============================================
    5: 
    6: Gate: S83-MULTIPAIR-N3-SATURATION  [VERIFY-THEOREM]
    7: Classification: PARTICLE + PHONONIC
    8: Owner: landau-condensed-matter-theorist
    9: 
   10: Purpose:
   11:   Verify that the canonical 8-mode Bogoliubov Hilbert space can host
   12:   N_pair = 3 Cooper pairs without violating Pauli exclusion. This is
   13:   the natural extension of the S59/S60/S61 multipair pair-transfer
   14:   construction (N_pair in {1, 2}) to the next admissible fermion-
   15:   parity sector.
   16: 
   17: Phononic framing:
   18:   Each Cooper pair is a phononic composite excitation: a bound
   19:   (k, -k) / (spin_up, spin_down) pattern on the substrate. Two pairs
   20:   cannot share the same k-level (Pauli), so the maximum number of
   21:   non-overlapping pairs on an N_mode Bogoliubov space is N_mode / 2.
   22:   For the canonical 8-mode basis (S36: 4 B2 + 1 B1 + 3 B3), the
   23:   saturation bound is floor(8/2) = 4. N_pair = 3 lies one step below
   24:   saturation, and the space of Pauli-compatible 3-pair configurations
   25:   should have dimension C(4, 3) = 4.
   26: 
   27: Substitution chain [VERIFY-THEOREM]:
   28:   Step 1 (definitions):
   29:     N_modes = 8  (canonical BCS Bogoliubov basis, S36 E_cond_ED_8mode)
   30:     Each mode = one (k, spin) fermion slot.
